visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair, wearing a brown t-shirt with a graphic on the front and tan corduroy pants, stands in a modern kitchen. He waves his hands and smiles energetically at the camera. The background features dark grey cabinetry and a white countertop. (2) A still photograph of two smiling men outdoors is overlaid on the screen while the main character points at it. (3) The man holds a square cardboard box for 'TOMMI Rice Burger' close to the camera, showing a picture of a rice burger and Japanese/Chinese text. (4) The camera shifts to a top-down view of a stainless steel sink where a bowl of oysters is being rinsed under running water. A hand reaches in to stir them. (5) Hands are shown mixing white powder with water in a small metal pot using a spoon. (6) A montage of ingredient photos (miso, sugar, salt, ketchup) appears over a white surface, followed by a hand holding a bottle of red chili sauce. (7) The man is shown cooking in a black frying pan; he adds oysters, starch slurry, a beaten egg, and chopped green vegetables. Steam rises from the pan. (8) He assembles a burger by placing the cooked egg and oyster mixture onto a white rice patty on a black plate. (9) He takes a large bite of the burger, closing his eyes and gesturing with his hand to indicate it is delicious. (10) He then eats a different rice burger, looking thoughtful. (11) He looks shocked while reading the back of the TOMMI box, pointing at the '2 minutes' text. (12) Close-up shots show the rice burger inside a microwave and a macro view of the meat filling being lifted with a fork. (13) The man walks away from the camera in frustration, leaving the kitchen as the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male voice introduces the challenge over an upbeat, synthesized pop track. A rapid 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a visual cut. (2) Continuous speech with high pitch variability. The sound of water running in a sink and splashing against porcelain is clearly heard during the oyster washing segment. (3) A distinct 'ding' sound effect occurs as a graphic appears. The vocal tone becomes comedic and slightly mocking. (4) The sizzling sound of food frying in a pan is layered with the fast-paced narration. Percussive 'thuds' match the rhythm of the editing. (5) The BGM shifts to a more dramatic, mock-epic style as the burger is tasted. (6) A microwave 'beep' and the hum of the machine are heard. The speaker shouts '料超多!!' with high arousal. (7) Final segment features the speaker's voice echoing slightly as he walks away, with the music fading out quickly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Challenge -> Execution -> Comparison -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously promote the TOMMI Pepper Bun Rice Burger by showing the labor-intensive process of making a homemade version and then revealing the convenience and quality of the commercial product.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator directly shows the product box, demonstrates how to use it, lists retailers where it can be purchased, and gives a positive review of its taste and convenience.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-energy 'vlog-style' editing technique common on social media to keep viewers engaged while delivering a clear marketing message for a food product.
